description.fr: Test d’entrée du KSK pour les emplois de Kommandosoldat, d’officier commando et de Kommandoaufklärungssoldat. Une première phase d’une semaine combine tests sportifs individuels et tests psychologiques et cognitifs informatisés (exigences cognitives plus élevées pour les officiers), suivie d’une phase de terrain dite « semaine de dureté » (Härtewoche). La réussite ouvre la formation de base de deux ans.
description.en: Entry test of the KSK for commando soldiers, commando officers and commando reconnaissance soldiers. A first one-week phase combines individual fitness tests with computer-based psychological and cognitive tests (higher cognitive standards for officers), followed by a field phase known as the “hardship week” (Härtewoche). Passing it gives access to the two-year basic training.

Elle se termine par un exercice final ; le commandant du KSK remet alors l’insigne spécial de commando (Sonderabzeichen Kommandosoldat, appelé Kommandoabzeichen), avant la spécialisation au sein du trupp.
description.en: Two-year course following the PFV that trains commando NCOs and officers: commando combat modules, several weeks of medical training (tactical casualty care), explosives, shooting and arctic training in North America. It ends with a final exercise, after which the KSK commander awards the commando special badge (Sonderabzeichen Kommandosoldat, known as the Kommandoabzeichen), before specialisation within the team.

description.en: Specialisation of commando soldiers that trains precision shooting and close reconnaissance within the team. Commando snipers continue their training abroad, for example at schools in Texas for shooting in strong, shifting winds or in Switzerland for uphill and downhill shooting, and train to shoot from helicopters.

description.en: Training of the medical personnel of the KSK’s Sanitätsspezialzug, aligned with NATO standards for special forces medical personnel (NATO Special Operations Medical Technician). It combines a tactical part (rescue from hard-to-reach places, extrication, insertion methods including by helicopter) with an advanced medical part; entry is through a one-week PFV close to the commando one.

L’accès passe par une procédure de sélection à Seedorf (Fallschirmjägerregiment 31) précédée de deux semaines de préparation, puis par une formation d’environ un an à l’Ausbildungszentrum Spezielle Operationen : armement et tir, combat rapproché, langues, transmissions, survie, soins tactiques.
description.en: Qualification of the Army’s specialised paratroopers, able to operate alongside special forces (seizing targets, evacuations). Entry is through a selection procedure at Seedorf (Fallschirmjägerregiment 31) preceded by two weeks of preparation, followed by about a year of training at the Special Operations Training Centre: weapons and shooting, close combat, languages, communications, survival and tactical casualty care.

Le PFV I associe test sportif et visite d’aptitude à la plongée (Taucherverwendungsfähigkeit) à l’institut de médecine maritime de Kiel ; le PFV II est un stage de sélection de six semaines (sport et infanterie) ; le PFV III, phase de plongée en piscine, clôt la sélection avant la formation de base.
description.en: Three-step selection of future combat swimmers lasting about six months. PFV I combines a fitness test with a diving fitness examination (Taucherverwendungsfähigkeit) at the naval medical institute in Kiel; PFV II is a six-week selection course (fitness and infantry); PFV III, a pool diving phase, ends the selection before basic training.

description.fr: Cursus de trois ans du KSM après le PFV : formation de base (plongée en eau libre, tir, combat terrestre, nage de 30 km en Baltique en deux jours), capacités élargies acquises dans d’autres écoles de la Bundeswehr, puis formation tactique d’engagement (accès aux bâtiments et navires, mobilité, chef d’opérations de plongée). Le diplômé rejoint la Kampfschwimmerkompanie, reçoit l’insigne « poisson-scie » et un numéro, puis se spécialise (medic, breacher, radio, EOD, tireur d’élite).
description.en: Three-year KSM course after the PFV: basic training (open-water diving, shooting, land combat, a 30 km two-day swim in the Baltic), extended skills acquired at other Bundeswehr schools, then tactical operational training (building and ship access, mobility, dive supervisor). Graduates join the combat swimmer company, receive the “sawfish” badge and a number, then specialise (medic, breacher, radio operator, EOD, sniper).

description.en: Track of the KSM special operations boat company, which trains boat operators (junior NCOs) and element leaders (senior NCOs). description.en: Sixteen-week basic training, with a strong tactical component, for the doctors and paramedics of the KSM’s Special Operations Medical Support Team, the first link of the rescue chain when combat swimmers deploy. description.fr: Formation, jusqu’à deux ans, des forces spécialisées de la Luftwaffe chargées de la recherche, du sauvetage et du rapatriement armés de personnel isolé (CSAR, récupération de personnel). Après une procédure d’évaluation du potentiel ouverte à toutes les armées, elle couvre le sauvetage tactique et technique, les soins aux blessés, la survie, le combat isolé, la chute libre opérationnelle, le fast roping et la conduite de véhicules.
description.en: Training of up to two years for the Luftwaffe’s specialised forces in charge of armed search, rescue and recovery of isolated personnel (CSAR, personnel recovery). After a potential assessment procedure open to all services, it covers tactical and technical rescue, casualty care, survival, lone-combatant training, operational free fall, fast roping and vehicle driving.

description.en: Static-line parachutist course of the Airborne/Air Transport School in Altenstadt (jumps with T-10 round canopies from transport aircraft). The course certificate also certifies the Fallschirmspringerabzeichen special badge, awarded in bronze after 5 jumps, silver after 20 and gold after 50; wear is authorised once entered in the military parachutist logbook.

description.en: Military free-fall course of the Airborne/Air Transport School, attended notably by the KSK, the parachute regiments’ Fallschirmspezialzüge and combat swimmers. Il est suivi par les forces spéciales, les forces spécialisées (Freifalltruppführer des Fallschirmspezialzüge) et les Kampfretter.
description.en: Course of about three and a half weeks, notably run in Arizona, that teaches how to lead a team of ram-air parachutists from the aircraft ramp to the landing zone, including at night under night-vision goggles and over about six kilometres of canopy flight. It is attended by special forces, specialised forces (free-fall team leaders of the Fallschirmspezialzüge) and the Kampfretter.

description.en: Specialist who prepares paratroopers for the jump, checks equipment before every jump, runs safety drills and commands the drop from the aircraft. Training is delivered at the Airborne/Air Transport School and requires solid jump experience; regiments then run annual continuation training (water jumps, door bundles, recovery of hung-up jumpers, new aircraft such as the A400M).

Ses membres, chuteurs opérationnels, sont formés à la Luftlande-/Lufttransportschule.

description.fr: Cours de quatre semaines de survie et d’exfiltration (Überleben und Durchschlagen) dans lequel les futurs cadres de l’Heer apprennent à conduire un groupe livré à lui-même à travers un territoire tenu par l’ennemi, sous « pression ennemie » permanente. Obligatoire pour les officiers et Feldwebel de l’Heer destinés au commandement de section ou de compagnie ; il donne l’insigne spécial Einzelkämpfer.
description.en: Four-week survival and evasion course (Überleben und Durchschlagen) in which future Army leaders learn to lead an isolated group back through enemy-held territory under constant “enemy pressure”. Mandatory for Army officers and Feldwebel destined for platoon or company command; it awards the Einzelkämpfer special badge.

Les diplômés reçoivent l’insigne Einzelkämpfer à deux feuilles de chêne portant la mention « Jagdkommando ».
description.en: Five-week advanced course following EKL1: selected soldiers are prepared for operating procedures in hostile terrain (Jagdkampf), including explosives and air transport exercises. Graduates receive the Einzelkämpfer badge with two oak leaves and the inscription “Jagdkommando”.

name.fr: Guide de haute montagne de l’Heer (Heeresbergführer)

description.fr: Plus haute qualification montagne de l’Heer : le Heeresbergführer conseille les chefs, forme les troupes de montagne et dirige les engagements en terrain difficile et les secours en montagne. Après un programme de candidat, la formation se déroule à la Gebirgs- und Winterkampfschule en deux parties de quatre mois (été : escalade, météorologie, secours y compris héliporté, courses dans les Alpes occidentales, au Mont-Blanc et dans les Dolomites ; hiver : instructeur DSV, nivologie, déclenchement d’avalanches). Elle a été binationale avec l’Autriche de 2015 à 2024.
description.en: Highest mountain qualification of the Army: the Heeresbergführer advises commanders, trains mountain troops and leads operations in difficult terrain and mountain rescues. After a candidate programme, training takes place at the Mountain and Winter Warfare School in two four-month parts (summer: climbing, meteorology, rescue including by helicopter, routes in the Western Alps, Mont Blanc and the Dolomites; winter: DSV instructor, snow science, avalanche blasting). It was run jointly with Austria from 2015 to 2024.

body.en: Mountain and Winter Warfare School (Mittenwald), part of the Infantry School

Elle est la voie d’accès habituelle vers la formation de Heeresbergführer.
description.en: Intermediate qualification of the mountain infantry, taught at the Mountain and Winter Warfare School by Army mountain guides, with a summer and a winter part and tours up to Mont Blanc or the Dolomites. It is the usual route towards Heeresbergführer training.

Après un test d’entrée à ski, elle porte sur le sauvetage planifié et improvisé, en partie sur la Zugspitze, et sur le secours par hélicoptère.
description.en: Training in a summer and a winter part attended in Mittenwald by soldiers of the high-mountain infantry platoon, so that mountain units have their own rescuers where no civilian rescue chain exists. After a ski entry test it covers planned and improvised rescue, partly on the Zugspitze, and helicopter rescue.

Soldiers learn military skiing and mountaineering with military equipment in summer and winter; leaders continue at the Mountain and Winter Warfare School.

description.en: Survival, evasion, resistance and extraction courses concentrated since 2003 at the Special Operations Training Centre: surviving in unknown terrain behind enemy lines, evading hostile forces, conduct in captivity and returning to friendly forces (personnel recovery). They are offered at several levels, from special and specialised forces (level C) to aircrews and personnel at risk (land and sea survival courses).

La formation se poursuit ensuite en binôme ou trupp dans l’unité ; un tireur est jugé pleinement opérationnel après environ deux ans.
description.en: After selection and six weeks of post training within the unit, candidates attend the central sniper course of the Infantry School in Hammelburg: shooting, observation, range estimation and stalking, assessed as individual tests. Training then continues in pairs or teams within the unit; a sniper is considered fully combat ready after about two years.

description.en: Regulated health profession in Germany, reached after three years of training ending with a state examination. description.fr: Qualification des pilotes de l’avion de transport A400M au Lufttransportgeschwader 62 de Wunstorf. Son inspection de formation, seul établissement militaire de formation de la Luftwaffe habilité à délivrer des licences civiles, forme des pilotes dans un cadre multinational et dispose notamment de deux simulateurs de vol complets ; l’entraînement au poser sur piste non revêtue fait partie de la formation des équipages.
description.en: Qualification of A400M transport aircraft pilots at Lufttransportgeschwader 62 in Wunstorf. Its training inspectorate, the only Luftwaffe military training establishment allowed to issue civil licences, trains pilots in a multinational framework and operates two full-flight simulators; landing on unpaved strips is part of crew training.

description.fr: Formation en deux phases des loadmasters de l’A400M à Wunstorf : d’abord une qualification de type sur l’A400M (maintenance de l’appareil, inspection prévol) et une première expérience pratique, puis les savoir-faire tactiques nécessaires aux engagements et évacuations (déplacement de l’appareil moteurs tournants, comportement en vol à basse altitude). L’inspection de formation du LTG 62 dispose d’un simulateur de soute (Cargo Hold Trainer).
description.en: Two-phase training of A400M loadmasters in Wunstorf: first an A400M type qualification (aircraft maintenance, pre-flight inspection) and initial practical experience, then the tactical skills needed for deployments and evacuations (moving the aircraft with engines running, low-level flight procedures). The LTG 62 training inspectorate operates a Cargo Hold Trainer.

description.en: Training of almost two years for CH-53 door gunners: weapons instruction (M3M, MG3), land and sea survival courses, then day and night firing at varying speeds and altitudes. Once all requirements are met, the gunner receives his aircrew licence.

description.fr: Pilotes officiers de la 4e escadrille du Hubschraubergeschwader 64, qui transportent et appuient les forces spéciales (insertion, appui feu, évacuation de blessés). Leur aptitude est vérifiée par une procédure d’évaluation du potentiel avant la formation aéronautique forces spéciales, longue et exigeante, qui se termine par un vol de contrôle opérationnel ; ils ont aussi une formation d’infanterie et une compréhension tactique des opérations spéciales.
description.en: Officer pilots of the 4th squadron of Helicopter Wing 64, who carry and support special forces (insertion, fire support, casualty evacuation). Their suitability is checked through a potential assessment procedure before the long and demanding special forces flying training, which ends with an operational check flight; they also have infantry training and a tactical understanding of special operations.

Comme les pilotes, il passe une procédure d’évaluation du potentiel et dispose d’une formation d’infanterie et tactique des opérations spéciales.
description.en: Crew member, usually a senior NCO, added to the H145M LUH SOF crew depending on the mission: he operates the rescue hoist and the MG6 minigun in the side doors. Like the pilots he goes through a potential assessment procedure and has infantry and special operations tactical training.

description.fr: Formation des contrôleurs qui guident l’appui aérien rapproché au profit des troupes au sol, notamment dans les Joint Fire Support Teams : trois semaines de théorie et de simulateur puis deux semaines de formation de base avec missions réelles à l’école JTAC franco-allemande près de Nancy, suivies d’une formation avancée en situations tactiques. L’anglais est indispensable ; la qualification s’entretient en exercice (Stoneage, Munster) et des JTAC-Evaluator contrôlent le niveau.
description.en: Training of the controllers who direct close air support for ground troops, notably within Joint Fire Support Teams: three weeks of theory and simulator work, then two weeks of basic training with live missions at the Franco-German JTAC school near Nancy, followed by advanced training in tactical situations. English is essential; currency is kept in exercises (Stoneage, Munster) and JTAC evaluators check proficiency.

description.en: Authorisation for engineers to prepare and fire demolition charges (destruction, tree felling, obstacles). KSK engineers obtain it alongside other courses (chainsaw, construction machinery, boat handling); in the airborne engineers, trained demolition specialists (Sprengmeister) calculate and place the charges.

La sélection (séminaire d’orientation, exercice de terrain) s’adresse à des soldats expérimentés de l’unité d’intervention du régiment ; la formation comprend un entraînement de deux semaines à l’Infanterieschule de Hammelburg.
description.en: Teams of the Air Force Regiment that protect aircraft and their crews during stopovers in high-risk areas. Selection (orientation seminar, field exercise) is open to experienced soldiers of the regiment’s intervention unit; training includes a two-week course at the Infantry School in Hammelburg.

description.fr: Spécialisation de la police militaire (Feldjäger) chargée de la protection rapprochée des hautes autorités militaires, dont l’inspecteur général, et de chefs militaires alliés. Les Personenschützer apprennent l’autodéfense, la conduite de berlines blindées et de véhicules protégés comme l’Eagle, et la coordination d’un dispositif de protection ; ils sont choisis parmi des Feldjäger ayant suivi une formation pluriannuelle.
description.en: Military police (Feldjäger) specialisation responsible for the close protection of senior military leaders, including the Chief of Defence, and of allied commanders. Close protection officers learn self-defence, driving armoured saloons and protected vehicles such as the Eagle, and coordinating a protection detail; they are drawn from Feldjäger with several years of training.

Il donne les bases de la planification et du travail d’état-major nécessaires dans les quartiers généraux nationaux et OTAN, dont un état-major de composante opérations spéciales (SOCC).

description.en: Medical service officer track: officer candidates (Sanitätsoffizieranwärter) study human medicine at a civilian university paid for by the Bundeswehr, obtain their licence to practise (Approbation) and serve as military physicians. description.en: Training of German Army officers at the Offizierschule des Heeres in Dresden: leadership, basic tactics, civic education and Innere Führung, before branch-specific training. It is open to officer-career candidates recruited with the Abitur or Fachhochschulreife.

C’est la voie d’accès aux postes d’officier des forces spéciales navales et du Seebataillon.
description.en: Initial training of German Navy officers at the Marineschule Mürwik (Flensburg): leadership, navigation, sea training and Innere Führung, usually followed by studies at a Bundeswehr university. It is the entry route to officer posts in the naval special forces and the Seebataillon.

description.en: Course taken by infantry officer candidates at the Infanterieschule in Hammelburg at the rank of Fahnenjunker: squad-leader and infantry tactical training before the officer course in Dresden.

description.en: Final part of infantry officer training at the Infanterieschule: platoon leadership in combat (module A), then, for paratroopers, the parachutist course and the branch-specific module B. Graduates take command of a platoon.

description.fr: Les officiers de carrière et officiers temporaires de longue durée étudient en principe dans l’une des deux universités de la Bundeswehr (Universität der Bundeswehr München, Helmut-Schmidt-Universität Hambourg) en cycle intensif trimestriel menant au bachelor puis au master. Ces universités forment aussi des sous-officiers en filières techniques.
description.en: Career officers and long-serving temporary officers normally study at one of the two Bundeswehr universities (Universität der Bundeswehr München, Helmut Schmidt University Hamburg) on an intensive trimester system leading to a bachelor’s and then a master’s degree. They also train NCOs in technical programmes.

description.en: Personnel security vetting under the SÜG act, at three levels (Ü1 simple, Ü2 extended, Ü3 extended with investigations). For soldiers it is carried out by the Military Counter-Intelligence Service (MAD); special forces require a high level before assignment.

description.fr: Au sein de l’équipe commando de quatre hommes (Kommandotrupp), chaque soldat acquiert après la formation de base une spécialité : armes, transmissions, sanitaire ou explosifs. Le spécialiste armes maîtrise l’ensemble de l’armement de l’équipe et en assure l’instruction.
description.en: Within the four-man commando team (Kommandotrupp), each soldier acquires a speciality after basic training: weapons, communications, medical or explosives. The weapons specialist masters the team’s entire weaponry and instructs the others on it.

description.fr: Spécialité transmissions de l’équipe commando, d’environ cinq mois selon la Bundeswehr : liaisons radio et satellitaires, transmission de données en toutes circonstances. Elle comprend des bases d’informatique et d’électrotechnique (Universität der Bundeswehr München) et des cours matériels à l’école IT de la Bundeswehr.
description.en: Communications speciality of the commando team, about five months according to the Bundeswehr: radio and satellite links and data transmission under all conditions. It includes basic informatics and electrical engineering (Universität der Bundeswehr München) and equipment courses at the Bundeswehr IT school.

description.en: Medical speciality of the commando team: after a multi-week medical course during basic training, the specialist provides advanced combat care and casualty management until evacuation.

description.en: Explosives and engineer speciality of the commando team: breaching and demolition charges, opening passages and field engineering. It builds on the explosives training received during commando basic training.

description.en: Each KSK commando company includes a platoon specialised in waterborne infiltration (boats, swimming, diving). Commandos assigned to it receive additional amphibious operations training after basic training.

description.fr: Les sapeurs du Pionierspezialzug soutiennent les opérations du KSK par la construction, le forage, la découpe et le franchissement. Ils sont recrutés de préférence avec une formation artisanale achevée et reçoivent notamment le permis de conduite de bateaux de navigation intérieure ainsi que des cours de tronçonneuse et d’engins de chantier.
description.en: Engineers of the Pionierspezialzug support KSK operations through construction, drilling, cutting and crossing work. They are preferably recruited with a completed craft apprenticeship and receive, among others, the inland-waterway boat licence and chainsaw and construction-machinery courses.

description.fr: Formation des sous-officiers de la défense NRBC : radioprotection, reconnaissance NRBC, protection respiratoire, prélèvements et décontamination. Elle est dispensée à l’école de défense NRBC de Sonthofen, avec une partie finale aux États-Unis sur agents toxiques réels ; une formation de laborantin en biologie ou chimie est recherchée.
description.en: Training of CBRN defence NCOs: radiation protection, CBRN reconnaissance, respiratory protection, sampling and decontamination. It is delivered by the CBRN defence school in Sonthofen, with a final part in the United States using live agents; a biology or chemistry laboratory-technician background is sought.

body.fr: Schule ABC-Abwehr und Gesetzliche Schutzaufgaben, Sonthofen

description.fr: Les mécaniciens armement entretiennent et réparent les armes de l’unité. Ils suivent une formation civile reconnue de mécanicien de précision (Feinwerkmechaniker, environ deux ans) puis des cours spécifiques à chaque arme ; au KSK, ils assurent la maintenance de tout l’armement des commandos.
description.en: Weapons maintenance technicians service and repair the unit’s weapons. They complete a civil-recognised precision-mechanic training (Feinwerkmechaniker, about two years) followed by weapon-specific courses; at the KSK they maintain the commandos’ entire weaponry.

reference.en: Official feature “Waffeninstandsetzerin beim KSK” (bundeswehr.de)

description.en: Qualification of an experienced JTAC authorised to evaluate and certify other controllers to NATO standards. In the Bundeswehr it is held notably by Luftwaffe liaison officers attached to Army brigades.

description.en: Training of infantry heavy mortar (120 mm) crewmen: emplacement, laying, fire procedures and ammunition safety. It covers the mortar platoons of the heavy companies of the paratroopers and mountain infantry.

description.en: Driving and operating training on the air-transportable Wiesel armoured weapon carrier used by the heavy companies of the light infantry, depending on the post held.

reference.en: Wiesel Wikipedia page and official feature on heavy mountain infantry companies

description.fr: Formation au recueil de renseignement par entretien avec la population et des interlocuteurs locaux, avec interprète au besoin. Elle est mise en œuvre notamment par les unités de reconnaissance aéroportée de la Luftlandebrigade 1.
description.en: Training in gathering information through conversations with the population and local contacts, with an interpreter if needed. It is used notably by the airborne reconnaissance units of Luftlandebrigade 1.

reference.fr: Article ESUT « Luftlandekräfte – einsatzbereit jederzeit weltweit »
reference.en: ESUT article “Luftlandekräfte – einsatzbereit jederzeit weltweit”

description.en: Specialist training of German Army combat engineers: demolitions, laying and clearing obstacles, crossing and mobility support. The Luftlandepioniere of Luftlandebrigade 1 add parachuting and, for some, demolitions-specialist qualification.

reference.fr: Reportage officiel « Luftlandepioniere im Gefecht » (bundeswehr.de)
reference.en: Official feature “Luftlandepioniere im Gefecht” (bundeswehr.de)

description.en: Specialist training of German Army signallers: electronics, high frequency, operating transmission/reception equipment and command networks. It applies notably to the HQ and signals company of Luftlandebrigade 1.

reference.en: Official career page “Soldatin/Soldat der Fernmeldetruppe”

description.fr: Après une sélection exigeante comprenant une phase de test de deux semaines, les Fernspäher suivent au moins trois ans de formation : reconnaissance profonde, survie, transmissions et insertion par parachute, en montagne et en milieu arctique ou amphibie (kayak). Une partie est dispensée à l’Ausbildungszentrum Munster ; ils servent à la Fernspähkompanie 1.
description.en: After a demanding selection including a two-week test phase, Fernspäher complete at least three years of training: long-range reconnaissance, survival, communications and parachute, mountain/arctic and amphibious (kayak) insertion. Part is delivered at the Ausbildungszentrum Munster; they serve in Fernspähkompanie 1.

L’accès passe par des tests de condition physique et d’escalade, puis une formation glaciaire (escalade sur glace, sauvetage en crevasse) encadrée par des Heeresbergführer.
description.en: The Hochgebirgsjäger of Gebirgsjägerbrigade 23’s high-mountain platoons fight at altitudes above 3,000 m. Entry requires fitness and climbing tests, followed by glacier training (ice climbing, crevasse rescue) supervised by Army mountain guides.

description.en: Specialist training of German Army reconnaissance soldiers: operating drones, optronic sensors and battlefield surveillance radars, observation and reporting. It applies notably to Gebirgsaufklärungskompanie 23.

Tout personnel navigant, pilote ou membre d’équipage, doit en outre être reconnu apte au vol militaire par le Zentrum für Luft- und Raumfahrtmedizin der Luftwaffe.
description.en: Pilot candidates go through a three-phase selection (officer aptitude, coordination tests and medical fitness, simulator). All aircrew, pilots and crew members alike, must also be certified fit for military flying by the German Air Force Centre of Aerospace Medicine.

Une licence EASA Part 66 (CAT A/B1) peut être prise en compte.
description.en: Civil-recognised aircraft-mechanic training (maintenance specialism) taken by Army aviation technical NCOs, supplemented by aircraft technical training at the Internationales Hubschrauberausbildungszentrum (Bückeburg). An EASA Part 66 (CAT A/B1) licence may be credited.

Ils sont eux-mêmes parachutistes expérimentés, chuteurs pour l’instruction en chute libre, et titulaires d’une qualification d’instructeur.
description.en: Instructors of the Luftlande-/Lufttransportschule in Altenstadt train parachutists from all services in static-line and free-fall jumping. They are experienced parachutists themselves, free-fall qualified for free-fall instruction, and hold an instructor qualification.
